headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2021, The Young Bucks vs. The Varsity Blonds went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.57. The Varsity Blonds was challenging for gold for the very first time. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Rewind to 2023, when Dustin Rhodes vs. Bishop Kaun headlined Rampage, rated 5.70.

On this day in 2021, Serena Deeb vs. Red Velvet went to battle over the NWA World Women's Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.05 ? a solid showing. It was the first title opportunity of Red Velvet's career. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2021, when Kingston & Moxley vs. The Acclaimed crossed paths for the first time ever on Dynamite, rated 6.20.
